{{Quote|Since there's nothing much below or above the ecliptic around there, that would put his point of origin somewhere in the Senex or Juvex Sector, or in the Ninth Quadrant, say, between the Greeb-Streebling Cluster and the Noopiths.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Children of the Jedi (novel)">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>}}
The '''Greeb-Streebling Cluster''' was located in the [[Ninth Quadrant]], which was part of the [[Bozhnee sector/Legends|Bozhnee sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], near the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex]] and [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex]] [[Sector/Legends|sectors]].

==Behind the scenes==
A fictional character played by British comedian Peter Cook throughout his career was called Sir [[Wikipedia:Arthur Streeb-Greebling|Arthur Streeb-Greebling]].
